name: DRA Consultants Limited
about: DRA Consultants Limited provides engineering consultancy services for urban and rural development, and industrial utility sectors in India. It offers public partnership, transaction advisory, bid process management, leak detection and NRW study, project management consultancy, survey, feasibility study, master plan report, detailed project report, water and energy audit, and industrial utility audit services; and GIS, MIS, and centralized monitoring systems. The company is also involved in the investment planning, procurement, bid preparation, bid process management, execution planning, quality assurance plan, cost control, project schedules, commissioning, trial runs, and performance monitoring; and provision of technical, commercial, legal, and financial advisory services for water supply, wastewater treatment, and water monitoring services. DRA Consultants Limited was founded in 1990 and is headquartered in Nagpur, India.
